title: Scholarship Eligibility Decision
instruction: Make the final decision on whether Student 3 (Mariam Nabil) is eligible for Brightpeak Academy's scholarship. Under the Scholarship Policy, a student is eligible only if their overall average across all recorded assignment grades is strictly above 90%. Give one short sentence of reasoning, then output the decision as a JSON object with no extra keys, in exactly this form: {"student_id": 3, "decision": "eligible"} or {"student_id": 3, "decision": "not_eligible"}.
notes: student_id 3 is real seed data (db/brightpeak.db) with an actual overall average of 91.0%, just above the 90% threshold. The correct decision is intentionally not stated or hinted at here -- planning.algorithms.environment.Environment determines correctness independently by querying the DB.
